shortDescription: Manages setting up the Nexus Dashboard.

options.name: app_network
options.description: The app subnet. This is a 'pod-to-pod' network and is used to run inter pod traffic.

options.name: app_network_ipv6
options.description: The IPv6 app subnet. This option is only applicable for ND version 3.0.1f and later.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The name of the ND cluster.

options.name: deployment_mode
options.description: This is used for enabling the services between Orchestrator, Fabric Controller and Insights during the initial installation. Depending on the number of nodes in the cluster, some services or cohosting scenarios may not be supported. If you are unable to choose the desired number of services, check your playbook and ensure that you have provided enough primary/secondary nodes. options.name: dns_search_domain
options.description: The DNS search domains.

options.name: dns_server
options.description: The IP address of the DNS server.

options.name: external_services
options.description: The persistent Service IPs/Pools to be provided. For ND versions between 3.1.1 and 3.2.2, this can only be used when O(deployment_mode) includes V(ndi) or V(ndo) otherwise it will be ignored. This option is only applicable for ND versions 3.1.1 and later.

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the Nexus Dashboard (ND) host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: ignore_proxy
options.description: Proxy is ignored for the list of host addresses provided in this option.

options.name: login_domain
options.description: The login domain name to use for authentication. The default value is DefaultAuth. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_LOGIN_DOMAIN) will be used instead.

options.name: nodes
options.description: The node details to set up Nexus Dashboard and bring up the User Interface.

options.name: ntp_config
options.description: This is used for configuring NTP server and its other options. This option is only applicable and required for ND version 3.0.1f and later.

options.name: ntp_server
options.description: The IP address of the NTP server. This option is only applicable and required for ND version 2.3.2d.

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this ND module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(ND_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: persona
options.description: The Nexus Dashboard implementation type. This option is only applicable for ND version 4.1.0 and later. This defaults to C(lan) when unset on creation.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for the REST connection. The default value depends on parameter `use_ssl`. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The password of the proxy server.

options.name: proxy_server
options.description: The proxy server.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: The username of the proxy server.

options.name: san_vendor
options.description: The Storage Area Network (SAN) vendor. This option is only applicable when O(persona=san) otherwise it would be ignored. This option is only applicable for ND version 4.1.0 and later. This defaults to C(cisco) when unset on creation.

options.name: service_network
options.description: The service subnet. This is a virtual level subnet used for communication within the cluster.

options.name: service_network_ipv6
options.description: The IPv6 service subnet. This option is only applicable for ND version 3.0.1f and later.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) for setting up Nexus Dashboard. Use C(query) for checking the installation status of Nexus Dashboard.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_TIMEOUT) will be used instead.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_USE_PROXY) will be used instead.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_USE_SSL) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(ND_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ND_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
